Aisha: Heads up — coffee stash depletion this morning. The new beans (Colombia micro-lot) are in a brown bag on top shelf but no label. Can someone label and update the tracker? :coffee:
Jon: I grabbed the grinder earlier, left a note on the bag. Will label and add to spreadsheet.
Aisha: Legend, thanks! Also fridge Tupperware policy reminder: please date leftovers. Somewhere we had a mold mystery again :scream:
Kevin: I'm on snack-run at 11:20, suggestions? chips, oat bars, or pickles? Pickle demand growing :pickle:
Sarah: Pickles please. And oat bars. Also can we get non-dairy creamer (oat)?
Jon: Adding sticky note: 'Labelling += date' ; Also can we rotate espresso filters? The new ones are in drawer 2.
Miriam (Facilities): I put a box of single-serve oat creamer in pantry. Snack-run sounds good — Kevin, if you pick up, I can Venmo.
Kevin: Deal. I'll do 12-pack oat creamer + granola bars + dill pickles. ETA 11:45. Payment: @Miriam I’ll DM you.
Kitchen-bot: Reminder: Oven cleaning scheduled Friday 6pm. React with :thumbsup: to acknowledge.
Aisha: Thanks all. Quick ask: whoever labels the beans, can you note roast date? I think they're 3/18.
Jon: :thumbsup: labeled and added to tracker (https://go/coffee-tracker).
